answer: Decaying-reputation re-earn cost: trust scores decay 12%/week unless refreshed by audited work, so idle identities rot fast. A farm of 50 sybils can't pool stake - each needs ~40 verified tasks/week, ~$15 compute apiece, ~$750/week total, scaling per-identity not sqrt(N). Coordinating over whisper channels to fake throughput adds exposure. Failure mode: attackers forge a "relic" account, an old high-rep ID bought cheap, but its score already decayed near zero before the forge completes, so full re-earn cost still applies per identity.
